k:HH.Honor.ToggleDesc: Run this business unattended: guests take what they want and leave the money in the honor box, at the full price. Nobody needs to be on duty, but some guests pay less than the price and a few pay nothing at all (chances in the settings; fewer when a colonist can see them). The sign's report shows what went missing.
